2.2.1 Use of Horizontal Drains in Australia

The only information available at present on the Australian use of
horizontal drains relates to the construction of the Murray 2 power
station in southeastern Australia, on the borders of Victoria and New
South Wales. The following information on the scheme was kindly supplied
to the Geotechnical Control Office (GCO) by the Snowy Mountains
Hydro-Electric Authority (1983).
